quotes: S7-N5c

The check never counts the part being saved. Changing a part's number only in upper and lower case, hyphens, asterisks, periods or spaces, for example FF-5507 to FF5507, saves when no other part at the location matches it.
S7-N5b

S7-N3 and S7-N4 apply when a part is created and when its part number is changed. Saving a part with its number unchanged is never refused by them, even when the location already holds a part whose number matches it.
S7-N3
If a part with the same number is already stocked at this location and is active, the save is refused with "{part number} already exists at this location."
PRD §4 Key Decisions (duplicate at the location)

A new part number already stocked at the location is refused, ignoring case and punctuation. This check stops a second copy of a part at one location. It runs when a part is created or its number is changed, never when a part is saved with its number unchanged.
